## What changed?

Describe the user-facing behavior and the technical change. Link an issue when one exists.

## Validation

- [ ] `Validate pull request` is passing.
- [ ] I ran the targeted local test or documented why it cannot run in CI.
- [ ] I checked `git diff --check`.
- [ ] I updated user-facing documentation or confirmed none is needed.

## HapticFlight-specific checks

- [ ] This does not modify `Export.lua` or install into DCS/SimHub as part of validation.
- [ ] Profile or telemetry changes preserve their capability/recording evidence and identify any untested live-seat behavior.
- [ ] If this affects a release, the rollback path and required package/release-gate evidence are documented.
